blog_title: Bulk T-Shirt Business: 9 Years, No Udhaar, Prepaid Only
caption:
220 GSM on the label. Scratchy mess in hand. 😬

A customer ordered 400 pieces—GSM matched perfectly, but the yarn was wrong. Open end instead of ring spun combed. Short, twisted fibers = rough fabric, patchy prints.

Here's the 5-second test: rub it near your ear. Scratchy sound? Open end scam. Smooth glide? Ring spun. Don't trust GSM alone.

Save this if you're sourcing your next bulk order 👇
